latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generation Kling.

- Generate 5-second AI videos from text or image prompts in 1–3 minutes
- Upload and process JPG, PNG, WEBP, and MP4 files up to 50MB
- Simple session management and automatic token handling for free use (no subscription needed)
- Supports exporting videos up to 1080p MP4; other formats available
- Provides credit tracking, job status updates, and user-friendly error handling
- Designed for quick, free video creation for content creators, social media, and marketers
